name: JBT Marel Corporation
summary: JBT Marel Corporation provides technology solutions to food and beverage industry in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The company operates through Protein Solutions and Prepared Food and Beverage Solutions.
